title: Soil Moisture Irrigation Deficit by Bed
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor sensor_type=soil_moisture
| stats latest(moisture_pct) as moisture_pct by bed
| where moisture_pct<25
| sort moisture_pct
description: Uses ESPHome plant sensors telemetry to monitor soil moisture for each monitored bed in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for garden zones that are drying out before plants show stress, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest ESPHome plant sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Bed table of latest soil moisture percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It totals soil moisture for each monitored bed so you can spot garden zones that are drying out before plants show stress before it becomes annoying.
